:::{#thm-modus-ponens}
#### Modus ponens

For [propositions](#def-proposition) $P$ and $Q$,
this is a [rule of inference](#def-rule-of-inference):

$$
\frac{P \Rightarrow Q, \quad P}{Q}
$$

:::

::: proof

By the definition of [implies](#def-implies),
$P \Rightarrow Q$ is false
only when $P$ is true and $Q$ is false.
Both [premises](#def-premise) are true,
so $P$ is true and $P \Rightarrow Q$ is true.
So $Q$ is not false,
and the [conclusion](#def-conclusion) $Q$ is true.

:::
